apps.name: WordPlay
apps.changelog: Five daily Scramble formats: One Perfect Word, Word Rush, Stack Attack, Tile Tactics and Free Rein | Fuller starting boards, with the same letters and draw order for everyone | Scramble results show rival scores, ranks, word breakdowns and a board review | Win, loss and tie alerts when someone challenges your score
apps.tagline: Boggle-style Bungle and Scrabble-style Scramble, with rule-changing modifiers, online multiplayer and leaderboards.
apps.description: WordPlay is two word games in one, each a custom take on a classic. Bungle is the Boggle side: swipe adjacent letters on a dice grid before the clock runs out. Scramble is the Scrabble side: place tiles to build crossing words on a board with premium squares. More than 25 modifiers then change the rules. Gravity drops the letters above into the gaps you leave, Reroll replaces the letters you use, Turf War turns the grid into territory, Sabotage lets you set trap words, and Scramble adds barriers, stacking tiles and secret Clash rounds. Combine them into your own modes and save them. Every mode plays solo, passed around one device with up to eight players, or live online through room codes and public lobbies. Daily boards, weekly seasons and career leaderboards rank your scores against everyone else's.
features: Bungle: 4×4 and 5×5 letter grids checked against a real dictionary
Scramble: tile boards in three sizes with premium squares, tile exchanges and a Bungle Finale
More than 25 modifiers, such as Gravity, Turf War, Sabotage, Letter Lock and Word Grid
Build your own modes from any mix of rules, or load presets like Zenith of Chaos
Live online rooms and public lobbies, pass and play for up to eight, solo and Vs Raid

Seasons, career leaderboards, 50+ awards and a word gallery with definitions

Read the letter and the category, hold the microphone button and say your answer, then release and pass it on. Answers are transcribed in the background, and after the match you can replay the recordings and settle the scores.
features: Timed or round-based matches for 2 to 8 players
Push-to-talk answers, with audio replay after the game
Editable transcripts and scores
Saved player rosters, custom decks and match history
A retro console look
apps.pro: Transcription needs Pro access or your own Groq key. Recording, play, decks and review are free.

apps.tagline: An ear-training game across a sky campaign: notes, intervals, chords and more.
apps.description: Earbound teaches your ear to recognise notes, intervals, chords, inversions, scales, modes and progressions. Play a 480-match campaign across eight sectors of the sky, learn with short hands-on lessons, practise in a studio you can customise, or play with friends. Play on your phone or your computer: no account, no subscription, and no connection needed for solo play.
features: A 480-match campaign across eight sectors

Placement matches, so experienced listeners skip ahead
A practice studio with 17 exercises and ten difficulty levels
Answer by tapping, on a piano keyboard or by voice
More than 100 achievements and detailed records
Party play for 2 to 8 on the same Wi-Fi, or pass the phone

apps.name: RykerFM1
apps.changelog: First RykerSoft release | A library of every firmware on The Firmware Hub, as pictures or a dense index | Install a firmware on the FM-1 over USB from the phone | A watch list that tells you when a firmware has a new version | Favourites, pins, ratings, lists and notes that stay on the phone
apps.tagline: Browse the community firmware for the M-Vave FM-1 and install it over USB from your phone.
apps.description: RykerFM1 is for owners of the M-Vave FM-1 who run community firmware on it. The Library shows every firmware on The Firmware Hub with its maker's picture and words: browse, search and filter it, and open a page for any firmware with its release notes and links. The Bench installs a firmware on the FM-1 over a USB-C data cable, checks the package first, and keeps a history so you can put back what you had. Favourites, ratings, lists and notes stay on your phone: no account, and nothing is uploaded.
features: Every firmware on The Firmware Hub, as pictures or a dense index
Search, filters by type, style and sound engine, and the hub's orders
Install over USB from the phone, with the package checked first
A watch list and a daily check for new versions
An install history, and one tap to put back the firmware you had
Favourites, pins, ratings, lists and notes that stay on the phone
Keep a package on the phone to install without a connection
